2	//! squash-push ceremony into a single command.
3	//!
4	//! See `notes/chores/chores-05.md > Add push subcommand (0.37.0)` for the
5	//! original design.
6	//!
7	//! The run is a straight line: review -> message -> commit-work ->
8	//! commit-bot -> bookmark-set -> push-work -> squash-push-bot. There
9	//! is no saved state and no resume, because a recorded position
10	//! describes a world that may have changed for reasons push cannot
11	//! know. What push owes instead is that **rerunning is always
12	//! safe**: every stage checks its own precondition and no-ops when
13	//! its work is already done, so a rerun after a failure is simply a
14	//! run.
15	//!
16	//! Failures before `push-work` are rolled back from `jj op`
17	//! snapshots taken moments earlier in this same process. Failures
18	//! from `push-work` on have crossed the remote boundary — push
19	//! stops and reports, and putting the repos right is the user's
20	//! call, not something a tool can infer.

I reverted all of those back to `→`, and also caught one line in `todo_helpers.rs` (an `assert_eq!` at line 442) that had been needlessly reflowed from single-line to multi-line even though it never contained an em dash; restored it to the original single-line form. Verified afterward: line counts and arrow-character counts in all 15 files now match `HEAD` exactly except for the intended em-dash-to-punctuation edits.

**Genuinely ambiguous sites** (reported by the sub-agents, my spot checks confirmed the choices are reasonable):
- `src/push.rs:360` — comma used for a second break to avoid a double-colon reading.
- `src/push.rs:646-647` (paired dashes) — split as colon + comma rather than parens, since the middle clause wasn't a removable aside.
- `src/push.rs:678,709` — comma vs. colon judgment calls on short prepositional/consequence asides.
- `src/config_cmd.rs:40,477`, `src/show.rs:11`, `tests/cli_keep.rs:53` — pre-existing colon already on the line, so the em dash became a comma to avoid a double colon.
- `src/todo_helpers.rs:129-130` and `src/push/integration_tests.rs:202-204` — genuine paired-em-dash asides, converted to parentheses per rule 2.
- `src/push/integration_tests.rs:462` — split into two sentences (rule 4) since a second comma would have made a run-on.
- `src/config_schema.rs:256` — `"(required; role-specific — see init)"` already inside parens, so a comma was used instead of nested parens.
- `src/config_schema.rs:319`/`96` — the em dash there is a literal separator in `format!("{} — {}", ...)` used to build generated `.vc-config.toml` comment/output text; converted to `": "`, which changes generated output text, not just doc comments (flagged since it's more than a docstring wording change, though required to satisfy "convert every em dash").
- `src/options_flags/account.rs:6` / `src/options_flags/dry_run.rs:6` — each had two dashes on one line; split into colon (parenthetical) + comma (trailing clause).
